pages.title: Eggspansion
pages.creator: PBF
pages.description: Start a chicken farm in Eggspansion and turn each batch of eggs into money at the market. Buy chickens, look after them, and put what you earn back into production. As more eggs come in, decide which upgrades will help your small pen grow into a bigger operation.

pages.title: Moto Extreme: Halloween Land
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Ride a motorcycle through dark Halloween courses in Moto Extreme: Halloween Land. Keep the bike balanced as the track rises and falls, then adjust your speed to get over obstacles. Work your way to the finish on each side-scrolling course without losing control.

pages.title: Needle in a Haystack
pages.creator: Coder Gautam
pages.description: Search a pile of 1.5 million straws for ten needles in Needle in a Haystack. The light fades when you enter the pile, so follow the detector and listen for its ticks to speed up as you close in. Earn coins for each needle and spend them on power-ups from the merchant.

pages.title: Cozy Sort: Theme Collect
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Organize colorful objects into groups of three in Cozy Sort: Theme Collect. Look for items that belong together and move them into position to clear a match. You can take your time with each arrangement, since the levels let you sort without a countdown.

pages.title: Vex Try To Fly
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Launch Vex from a cannon in Vex Try To Fly and see how far you can send him. Use bounce platforms, wind, and boosts such as jetpacks or jump potions to stay in the air. Watch for obstacles and upgrade between attempts as you work on timing the slam.

pages.title: Fruit Match
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Tap a fruit in Fruit Match to release it, then send an identical one after it. A pair merges automatically once both fruits reach the basket. If a piece gets caught on the way down, clear some fruit below it and let gravity do the rest.

pages.title: Ludo Star
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Roll the dice and move your tokens from base to the center in Ludo Star. Land on a rival’s token to send it back to the start, and watch where other players can reach before choosing a move. Try different modes, climb the trophy road, and unlock dice skins.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Aura
pages.creator: Skilli
pages.description: Aim colored shots in Bubble Shooter Aura and use them to pop matching bubbles. Look for groups that will open up the board when they disappear, then check the new layout before your next shot. Clear each level and see how high you can take your score.

pages.title: Dr. Parking
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Drive different vehicles into marked spaces in Dr. Parking. Steer through obstacles, leave enough room at each corner, and line the car up before pulling into the spot. Keep an eye out for keys as you work through the parking lot.

pages.title: Wheel in the face
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Ram opposing vehicles in the enclosed arenas of Wheel in the face. Dodge traps and choose how to attack, whether you’re swinging a sword, firing a shotgun, or using a flamethrower. Spend your winnings on cars, weapons, and wheels as you work your way up the ranks.

pages.title: Zombie Road
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Drive through the undead in Zombie Road and try to reach the end of the route. Equip your car with defenses and watch where zombies gather so you can drive through them. Keep moving through the outbreak and make use of the car’s upgrades as the road gets more dangerous.

pages.title: Bark & Blast
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Help a stranded alien dog escape a post-apocalyptic planet in Bark & Blast. Guide the dog through 2D platforming sections and aim your attacks as you fight through the dangers along the way. Keep exploring to find a route off the planet.

pages.title: Secret Galaxy. Match-three
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Help pilot Inessa and her robot A.S.K.A. return home in the match-three game Secret Galaxy. Their ship is damaged, so solve puzzles to open a route through space. Set up matches and use bonuses or portals to clear obstacles such as asteroids and laser traps.

pages.title: Deadly Parkour
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Use two characters with different abilities to get through Deadly Parkour. Work out which character can make the next move and time each jump to clear the hazards. The game has 70 hand-built levels that test your control as well as your choice of route.

pages.title: Makeup Fruits
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Give fruit a makeover in Makeup Fruits. Pick out powder, lipstick, eyelashes, and accessories to create a face, then take an in-game selfie of the result. Earn gems as you play and use them to unlock more options for your next design.

pages.title: Cat Chaos Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Make as much mess as you can as a cat in Cat Chaos Simulator. In Room Naughty, jump onto tables, knock over cups, and wreck computers to raise the mess meter. Explore other settings, including parks, and see what you can get away with there.

pages.title: Imposter Coloring Book
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Color crewmates, imposters, and spaceship scenes in Imposter Coloring Book. Pick a brush such as pastel, watercolor, or pencil, then choose the colors you want to use. Change tools to give different parts of the same page their own texture, or start a new scene and try another combination.

pages.title: Mini Shooters
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Build a loadout and fight in 2D deathmatches in Mini Shooters. Use movement to get a clear shot while staying out of enemy fire. Try different weapons to find ones that suit how you handle encounters and reposition when the action moves across the battlefield.

pages.title: Overprotective Boyfriend
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Choose an outfit for Princess Marie in Overprotective Boyfriend. The knight in her life has opinions about what she wears, but Marie has a look of her own in mind. Try different clothes as she gets ready in front of the mirror and put together the outfit you want her to wear.

pages.title: Bricks Breaker. Gravity Balls
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Aim a stream of bouncing balls at the blocks in Bricks Breaker. Gravity Balls. Look at the layout before you shoot and choose an angle that lets gravity and rebounds carry the balls into more targets. Break every block on the board to complete the level.

pages.title: Cargo Skates
pages.creator: Sixcube
pages.description: Gather goods along a skating course in Cargo Skates. Swipe to steer your character toward the supplies and find a way past the obstacles. Keep collecting until you have enough stock to open the supermarket at the end of the run.

pages.title: Runic Block Collapse
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Tap a block to remove its connected group in Runic Block Collapse. A single block costs 250 points to clear, while larger groups earn more points per block. Look for clusters before you act and build your score to the level’s target, or start over if you fall short.

pages.title: Fish Eat Grow Mega
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Swim through the ocean in Fish Eat Grow Mega and eat smaller fish to grow. Stay clear of bigger fish while you look for your next meal and explore more of the ocean. Pick your fish and see how large you can get on your own or in two-player mode.

pages.title: Tile Match Connect 3 Tiles
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Clear the board by selecting matching sets of three in Tile Match Connect 3 Tiles. Keep an eye on the timer while you work through layouts that get harder as you go. Between puzzles, decorate a room and choose how you want the space to look.

pages.title: Laser Nodes
pages.creator: Eggys Games
pages.description: Guide a laser through every node at once in Laser Nodes. Look at where the beam travels and adjust the layout until it lights the full set of targets. Later puzzles let you bounce the beam off mirrors and other objects to reach nodes out of its direct path.

pages.title: Bricks and Balls Pinball
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Use pinball flippers to keep the ball in play in Bricks and Balls Pinball. Each rebound sends it into a formation of bricks, so time your next return to reach the pieces you missed. Keep hitting the ball back up to break through the layout.

pages.title: Healing Driver
pages.creator: Lipsar Studio LLC
pages.description: Drive an ambulance to find patients in Healing Driver. Tap to accelerate and brake before obstacles, then take the patients back to the hospital. Find a place for each patient and use their symptoms to decide what treatment they need before heading out again.

pages.title: Package Delivery!
pages.creator: Realinspirer
pages.description: Pick up parcels as you run in Package Delivery! Try to collect as many as you can before the run ends, then trade them in at the shop. Choose upgrades or power-ups that can help you go farther and grab more parcels on your next attempt.

pages.title: Barbiecore
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Build casual and sporty outfits for Ellie in Barbiecore. Work with hot pink and bubblegum shades as you choose pieces for each look. Try different combinations to see how a small change in color or style can take the outfit in a new direction.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Arcade
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Shoot bubbles into matching groups in Bubble Shooter Arcade. Check the color you’re about to fire, then find a spot where it can connect with bubbles already on the board. Clear enough space to reach clusters farther back and keep shooting until the board is empty.

pages.title: Squid Game Shooter
pages.description: Fight through a series of survival challenges in Squid Game Shooter. Use weapons such as shotguns and bazookas against enemies in 3D arenas. Stay aware of where opponents are coming from and work through the levels as you try to be the last contender standing.

pages.title: Skeleton Hunter
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Take back a city from the undead in Skeleton Hunter. Use your bow to pick off skeletons as they approach and look for traps in the ground that can take out a group. More skeletons arrive as you clear them, so stay ready for the next attack.

pages.title: Puzzle Blocks Ancient
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Rotate pieces and fit them into the board in Puzzle Blocks Ancient. Look at the outline you need to fill, then turn each block until it fits with its neighbors. The game has 60 levels, with a new arrangement to work out after each finished board.

pages.title: Numblocks Solitaire
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Match numbers in pairs to collect every block in Numblocks Solitaire. Move blocks between stacks to bring matching values together and uncover ones that are harder to reach. Work through all 60 levels, using the stacks to set up your next pair before you make a move.

pages.title: Hyper Swiper
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Combine numbers in Hyper Swiper to build the highest value you can. Check how one merge will affect your next options, because you only get a limited number of moves. Try to line up a sequence of merges that takes you farther than a single quick match.

pages.title: Trap Craft
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Protect a portal from zombies in Trap Craft. Place traps, fight off attackers, and bring friendly pets along for the defense. The Hacker offers a wish to whoever holds off the zombies, and each character has a different ending to discover when you succeed.

pages.title: City Siege 4. Alien Siege
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Lead a rescue mission on another planet in City Siege 4. Alien Siege. Use advanced units and laser weapons to fight hostile plants as you look for gems and the people they’ve abducted. Choose where to move your team so you can reach the captives while dealing with the plants in your way.

pages.title: Video Game Tycoon
pages.creator: Holy Cow Studio
pages.description: Run a game studio in Video Game Tycoon. Develop games for computers, consoles, and mobile devices, then use the money they bring in to grow the business. Build up the studio over time as you work toward becoming a leader in mobile games.

pages.title: Phone Case Salon
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Design a phone case in Phone Case Salon. Pick a base color, then try stickers and glitter to decorate it. See which details work with the colors you picked, and put together a finished case that looks the way you want before trying another design.

pages.title: Soccer Champ
pages.creator: SBC Games
pages.description: Kick when the ball passes over the crosshair in Soccer Champ. Use one button to take your shot and build your score within the 30-second round. Precise kicks add time, so watch the target closely if you want to keep the round going longer.

pages.title: Blox Escape
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Slide blocks out of the way in Blox Escape to open a path for the piece marked with a star. Look for moves that give the longer blocks space to shift before you try the exit. There are 25 layouts, and you can work through each one without a timer.

pages.title: Colors Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description: Make groups of at least three bubbles of the same color in Colors Bubble Shooter. Bounce shots off the walls to reach awkward spots, and clear next to ice blocks to thaw them. Use lightning and sun bombs when you want to clear more of the board at once.

pages.title: Anime Jigsaw Puzzles
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Reassemble six anime illustrations in Anime Jigsaw Puzzles. Look for lines, colors, or background details that continue between pieces and use those clues to put each image back together. Clear the current picture to move on to another illustration.

pages.title: Backgammon
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description: Roll two dice and move your checkers around the points in Backgammon. Decide how to use each roll to bring your 15 pieces home, then start taking them off the board. Finish bearing off your checkers before the other player to win.

pages.title: ANIMAL PAINT
pages.creator: nau.games
pages.description: Choose colors for animal pictures in ANIMAL PAINT. Pick a shade and apply it to the part of the drawing you want to fill, then use different colors for the remaining details. Try a second palette on another animal to give it a different look.

pages.title: BTS Nerf Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose from four toy blaster pictures in BTS Nerf Coloring Book. Pick the colors you want and fill in the different parts of the design. Try making the body and smaller details stand out from one another, or give the whole blaster a coordinated color scheme.

pages.title: Virus Ninja 2
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Slice through dangerous germs in Virus Ninja 2. Watch for virus strains as they appear and cut through them to stop the outbreak from spreading. Keep your attention on the play area so you can react as the next targets come into view.

pages.title: Colored Circle 2
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Tap to turn the ring in Colored Circle 2. Bring the section of the right color around to meet the ball before it reaches the edge. Watch the ball’s movement and line up each match in time to keep the game going.

pages.title: Pixel Apocalypse Shooting Zombie Garden
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Fight soldiers and zombies in Pixel Apocalypse Shooting Zombie Garden. Try modes such as Survival, Gun Game, or Team Deathmatch, or take on the 40 levels available offline. Join friends in multiplayer when you want to fight alongside or against other players.

pages.title: Monster Truck vs Zombie Death Shooting Game
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Take an armed monster truck into off-road battles in Monster Truck vs Zombie Death Shooting Game. Aim your missiles at rival vehicles and use your truck’s weapons to take them out. Beat the opposition to unlock the next mission and try another round of combat behind the wheel.

pages.title: Impossible Tracks Truck Parking Game
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Drive a transport truck along high stunt courses in Impossible Tracks Truck Parking Game. Steer through narrow sections and keep the truck under control as the route climbs or drops. Watch the edges and take each stretch at a speed that gives you room to correct your line.

pages.title: Cool Cars Memory
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Turn over cards to find matching vehicle pictures in Cool Cars Memory. Remember what each card showed so you can uncover its partner without wasting moves. Clear all the pairs across four levels and try to complete each board in as few moves as you can.

pages.title: Christmas Items Differences
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Find seven changes in each pair of holiday pictures in Christmas Items Differences. You have one minute per level, so scan the pictures carefully and select each detail that differs. Work through ten sets of images and see if you can finish every search before the timer ends.

pages.title: Link Line Puzzle
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Start at the black dot in Link Line Puzzle and draw one continuous path through every block to reach the end. Think about where each turn will leave you before moving on. Use a hint if your route keeps leaving a block out.

pages.title: Football Legends Big Head Soccer
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Play quick soccer matches in Football Legends Big Head Soccer. Move your player into position to meet the ball, then aim to get it past the opponent and into the goal. Work through the tournament by winning matches as you get used to the timing of each play.

pages.title: Addition Brain Teaser
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Combine all the numbers on the board in Addition Brain Teaser. You can always add two equal values. For different numbers, their sum must already appear somewhere on the board. Look for those combinations and check what will still be available after each move.

pages.title: Shape Shoot
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Time your shots to hit moving shapes in Shape Shoot. Watch how the targets move before firing and wait for them to line up with your aim. Clear the shapes as they come into range and see how high you can push your score.

pages.title: Robot Police Iron Panther
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Assemble the Iron Panther in Robot Police Iron Panther, then take it into a fight against an alien monster. Put the robot together before sending it into combat to defend Earth. Use your finished machine to go up against the creature that started the attack.

pages.title: 360 Smash
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: React to a fast-moving ball in 360 Smash. Hit it back when you have an opening or dodge it to throw off the opposition. Switch between attacking and getting out of the way as you try to knock your competitors out of the game.

pages.title: Airport Manager Games
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Handle a variety of airport jobs in Airport Manager Games. Check passengers’ passports at the counter, then switch to jobs like cleaning the cabin or refueling a plane. Each activity asks you to use different tools and take care of another part of getting the aircraft ready.

pages.title: Paint Gun
pages.creator: Webron
pages.description: Fire blue or yellow shots at matching balls in Paint Gun. Watch the color of the ball coming toward you, then switch your shot to match it before it reaches the gun. Keep clearing the incoming balls as you react to changes in color.

pages.title: Mad Hill Racing
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Drive over hills and dips in Mad Hill Racing. Manage your speed on the slopes so you can keep the vehicle under control, and pick up fuel to extend the run. Collect coins as you go and work toward taking another vehicle out over the hills.

pages.title: My Cars Memory
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Find matching car pictures in My Cars Memory. Flip two cards at a time and remember what was underneath when they don’t match. The four boards get harder as you go, and finding the pairs quickly helps you earn more points.

pages.title: Hop Stars
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Bounce a ball across platforms in Hop Stars. Land near the middle of each platform to keep a combo going and add bonus points to your score. Collect coins to unlock different balls and see how long you can keep the run going.

pages.title: Dogs Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pick an illustration in Dogs Coloring Book and use the brush to fill in the dog and its surroundings. Choose colors for the larger areas and change them as you work on smaller details. Move to another picture to try a different palette or color another dog.

pages.title: Fruit Slasher
pages.creator: KidsGames4All
pages.description: Slice flying fruit to score in Fruit Slasher. Aim for as many pieces as you can while keeping your blade away from the hamster. You only get a few mistakes, so watch what’s coming up before you swipe and see how high you can get on the leaderboard.

pages.title: Knife Horror 2
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Throw knives at rotating monsters in Knife Horror 2. Watch the target spin and wait for an open spot so your next knife clears the blades already stuck in it. Keep landing throws to defeat the monsters and work toward unlocking different knives.

pages.title: Valiant Knight
pages.creator: Urbanduckgames
pages.description: Help a knight prove himself worthy of marrying the princess in Valiant Knight. Change his direction to guide him along platforms and collect coins in the castle. Watch for spikes and other hazards, then make your way to the exit once you’ve found a route through the room.

pages.title: Mahjong Classic
pages.creator: CMC Online s.r.o.
pages.description: Clear the board by pairing exposed tiles in Mahjong Classic. Choose matching stones that you can reach, and use each removal to uncover other pairs. The season tiles can match other seasons, and flowers can match other flowers, even when their pictures differ.

pages.title: Doll Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Color doll illustrations in Doll Coloring Book. Choose shades from the palette and add glitter to the parts you want to sparkle. Each finished picture gets a frame, and you can save your favorite drawings after you’ve given them the colors you want.

pages.title: Candy Breaker
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Move the paddle to keep the ball in play in Candy Breaker. Aim the rebounds toward the bricks and hit sturdier ones more than once when needed. Keep the ball from falling off the bottom while you clear all the breakable pieces from the layout.

pages.title: Balloon Crazy Adventure
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Use a fan to steer a balloon in Balloon Crazy Adventure. Blow it in the direction you want and guide it past thorny hazards as it travels. The route takes the balloon through grasslands, over the sea, and into city and cloud settings.

pages.title: Stickman Archer 3 (2018)
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Use your bow to take down opposing archers in Stickman Archer 3 (2018). Shoot before they do, since two body hits or one hit to the head ends your run. Try the different modes, earn stars, and spend them on new skins.

pages.title: Fashion Eve with Royal Sisters
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Dress Anna and Elsa for New Year’s Eve in Fashion Eve with Royal Sisters. Try long or short dresses or put together a look with a top and jeans. Once the sisters are ready, choose presents for their guests, including Jasmine and Rapunzel.

pages.title: Heap Up Box
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description: Build a stable pile of boxes and stones in Heap Up Box. Place the pieces so they can hold their position for three seconds and complete the stage. Try all 25 levels and two extra challenges, and adjust the stack when a shape makes it start to lean.

pages.title: Alhambra Solitaire
pages.creator: Novel Games Limited
pages.description: Build eight foundations with two decks in Alhambra Solitaire. Four foundations start at aces and count up, and four start at kings and count down, with each pile staying in its own suit. Turn stock cards onto the waste pile and move available cards to the foundations when they fit.

pages.title: Dolly Wedding Runway
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Style Dove and Tris for a bridal runway in Dolly Wedding Runway. Open boxes to reveal dresses, shoes, and accessories, then make a wedding outfit for each doll. Try different combinations to earn five stars and see both looks under the runway lights.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Hero
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Design a spinner in Fidget Spinner Hero by choosing its shape, colors, and prints. Look through the options to find details that fit the style you have in mind. Try out the finished toy after decorating it, or go back and build another version.

pages.title: Sudoku Challenge
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Fill the missing numbers in Sudoku Challenge. Check the row, column, and box around an empty cell to rule out numbers already in use. Start where only one value can fit, then use each answer to narrow down the choices in other parts of the puzzle.

pages.title: Princess Makeup Ritual
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Help the princess get ready in Princess Makeup Ritual. Go through her makeup routine and decide which details you want to use for her look. Then choose an outfit to go with the makeup and finish dressing her for the day.
